summary: Testing complet des fonctionnalités Tags & Domaines (itération 78). Backend: 35 tests PASS 100%. Frontend: Toutes les fonctionnalités testées et opérationnelles. Onglet Tags admin fonctionnel avec sous-onglets, CRUD complet, modal de suppression avec avertissement d'usage.

issues: Utilisations tags (in SpotYou) shows 0 because tag_ids are not set in tag_points table (tag_points use domain_id directly). The SpotYou/domain counts are correct (via domain_id), but tag-level granularity stats will be 0 until tag_ids are populated on tag_points records. This is a data/design concern, not a bug in the display.
Test domains (dom_879eaa986dd9, dom_9695b7bccbc3) were showing in stats panel during tests - now cleaned up. The all-domains endpoint returns ALL including inactive ones which appear in stats.

action_items: Consider cleaning up stale deactivated test domains from previous iterations if they accumulate in production

The 'Utilisations tags dans les SpotYou' total in stats shows 0 because tag_ids JSONB column in tag_points is currently empty (SpotYou are linked to domains via domain_id, not via tag_ids). This is expected with current data but the counter may be misleading.
critical_code_review_comments: domain_routes.py: The DELETE /api/tags/{id}?mode=deactivate route returns success:true even for non-existent tags in cascade mode (silently deletes 0 rows) - only deactivate mode returns 404. This inconsistency is minor but could mask errors.

admin_routes.py L286-292: There are TWO /domains endpoints - one in admin_routes.py (GET /api/admin/domains) and one in domain_routes.py (GET /api/domains). The admin one returns ALL domains (including inactive) without pagination, which could be a performance issue with large datasets.
domain_routes.py: No validation that category's domain_id matches tag's domain_id when creating tags. A tag could be created with mismatched domain/category.
Overall file size: admin/index.tsx is 1518 lines - exceeds 700 line recommended limit. Should be split into separate component files.
seed_data_creation: Test domains created and deleted during testing (test_ui_domain, test_domain cleanup done via API)
